dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave (falcate) trailing edge exhibiting a smooth parabolic spline curve from the apex down to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a narrow pixel radius, resulting in a slightly rounded but sharp morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate steepness of approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convexity with a large radius curve fitted to the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum visible at the anterior terminus with a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel junction where the descending melon slope meets the horizontal rostrum plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Series of faint, vertical linear striations along the lateral flank and a small notch-like irregularity on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan/teal monochromatic luminance across the entire visible dermal surface, likely a byproduct of lighting or digital rendering.
